summary: The exact candidate fixes the prior valid-global-option checker bypass and updates the remaining documented command, but it is only partial documentation mitigation. Its guard incorrectly accepts an unsafe install when --prerelease=allow appears in a shell comment or belongs to another command on the same line, and uv 0.11.16 itself still silently resolves a manually entered plain install to sglang==0.5.9.

tests.command: printf 'sglang\n' | uv 0.11.16 pip compile - --no-cache --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_34 --python-version 3.12 (prepared base)
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the original resolver failure: sglang==0.5.9 and torch==2.9.1 were selected.
The candidate's embedded regression cases and current documentation pass.

tests.command: node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs (exact candidate plus temporary `uv --no-cache pip install sglang` fixture)
tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed the candidate fixes the concrete global-option counterexample from the prior review.

tests.command: node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs (exact candidate plus comment and multiple-command adversarial fixtures)
tests.what_was_measured: The checker incorrectly accepted both unsafe sglang installs because --prerelease=allow appeared elsewhere on each logical line.
Confirmed imports used candidate checkout source paths, including /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/layers/layernorm.py.

gpu_execution.evidence: Package resolution and the static documentation checker do not execute GPU code. The reported Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 TP=2 symptom needs unavailable weights and two GPUs; one assigned gfx950 GPU cannot qualify it.

remaining_counterexamples: `uv pip install sglang # add --prerelease=allow to avoid old releases` passes the candidate checker although the option is only in a comment.
`uv pip install --prerelease=allow requests; uv pip install sglang` passes the candidate checker although the sglang command has no prerelease option.
A user manually running plain `uv pip install sglang` with uv 0.11.16 still silently resolves to sglang==0.5.9; repository documentation cannot change the installed resolver.
remaining_limitations: The Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 TP=2 wrong-output consequence was not reproduced because the model weights and required two-GPU topology were unavailable.
No native source or build input changed, repository-environment.json supplied no native library, and no native rebuild was applicable.
No GPU claim is made from the assigned single gfx950 GPU.
